description: Return what Quo already knows about the verified caller so they never have to explain it again: their last ride and, only if they turned on their profile at /my-profile, their usual pickup spots, car, airports, private terminals, tail numbers, language and ride preferences, plus the people they book for. Also returns ready-to-use reserve_ride arguments for 'the usual' / 'same as last time', so the only thing left to ask the person is the day and time. Nothing is booked or changed by this call. Requires session_token from verify_code. If the profile is off, only the last ride is returned and the person can turn the profile on at /my-profile.
name: get_my_usual
title: Get my usual trips and preferences
